residency_notes: AkashML runs on the decentralized Akash Network and third-party compute providers, so the public policy does not identify a single execution or data-residency region. Text prompts and transient API inputs are not retained after processing except for brief failed-request troubleshooting logs; saved outputs, voice data, and moderation or legal exceptions follow separate retention rules.
prompt_training_notes: AkashML says it does not collect or store prompts or API inputs shared with third-party models except limited third-party error logging used to troubleshoot failed requests.
